title: Financial Controller
description:
We're Hiring | Financial Controller

**HARRISON | Delhi | Full-Time | On-Site**

**About HARRISON**

HARRISON is a new-generation house of fashion and lifestyle brands, building distinctive consumer brands for India and global markets.

**Our portfolio includes REVOLTE, Atelier Rebel, Sugar Rush, and Ministry of Style**
, supported by a network of 400+ global factories, specialized category teams, and technology-driven operations.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**commercially driven Financial Controller**
to lead financial management, business planning, profitability analysis, and financial reporting.

The role requires a strong blend of
**financial expertise, analytical capabilities, and strategic business acumen**
, working closely with leadership to drive growth, cost efficiency, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

* **Financial Planning & Analysis:**
  Budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, business planning, and variance analysis.
* **Sales & Profitability:**
  Analyze revenue, margins, category-wise/SKU-wise profitability, region wise profitability, unit economics, and business performance.
* **Pricing & Cost Control:**
  Product costing, pricing strategy, margin optimization, expense monitoring, and cost reduction initiatives.
* **Marketing Analytics:**
  Evaluate marketing spend, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, and campaign-level profitability.
* **Investor & Management Reporting:**
  Prepare investor decks, financial presentations, business plans, MIS dashboards, and strategic performance reports.
* **Accounting & Compliance:**
  Oversee financial statements, accounting operations, taxation, audits, and statutory compliance.
* **Working Capital Management:**
  Monitor cash flows, inventory, receivables, payables, and working capital efficiency.
* **Business Partnering:**
  Collaborate with merchandising, marketing, operations, and leadership teams on commercial and financial decisions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* CA / CPA / CMA / MBA Finance or relevant finance qualification.
* **Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred**
  .
* Strong experience in financial controlling, FP&A, financial modelling, and business analysis.
* Proficiency in
  **Excel, ERP systems, MIS reporting, and financial presentations**
  .
* Solid understanding of product costing, pricing, financial controls, and profitability analysis.
* Experience in
  **retail, fashion, e-commerce, FMCG, or consumer businesses**
  preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset.

Why Join HARRISON?

Be part of a fast-scaling fashion and lifestyle business with direct exposure to
**business strategy, financial decision-making, investor reporting, and profitable growth**
.

**Location:**
Delhi

**Employment:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Interested candidates can apply via LinkedIn or share their CV on hitesh@harrisonexim.com**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a
**CMA / Cost Accountant**
to strengthen our cost accounting, inventory controls and financial closure processes. The role will focus on
**COGS, product costing, inventory valuation, yield & wastage analysis, cost control and month-end closure**
.

The role will work closely with Finance, Operations and Procurement teams to
**identify cost variances, improve inventory accuracy, strengthen controls and provide actionable insights on product margins and cost efficiency**
. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with costing and inventory, and a good understanding of ERP/accounting systems.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Product Costing & COGS:**

* Review and validate monthly COGS and product-level costing.
* Analyse standard BOM vs. actual consumption and identify material consumption variances.
* Review changes in raw material, packaging and other input costs and assess their impact on product margins.
* Support standard costing and periodic revision of product costs.
* Analyse product/customer/channel-level gross margins and identify significant cost deviations.

**2. Inventory & Stock Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly closing stock reconciliation between Tally, EasyEcom and operational records.
* Reconcile inventory sub-ledger with the General Ledger and investigate variances.
* Review inventory movements including purchases, production, sales, returns, transfers, adjustments and write-offs.
* Ensure appropriate inventory valuation and accounting treatment.
* Identify and track slow-moving, obsolete, damaged and expired inventory.

**3. Yield & Wastage Analysis**

* Monitor production yield and wastage against standard norms.
* Analyse actual wastage versus standard/approved wastage levels.
* Identify reasons for abnormal wastage and coordinate with operations/procurement teams for corrective actions.
* Track material consumption efficiency and highlight recurring variances.

**4. Expense & Cost Control**

* Review major operating and production-related expenses against budget/previous periods.
* Analyse significant expense variances and provide explanations.
* Ensure appropriate expense provisioning at month-end for goods/services received but invoices not yet received.
* Review provision workings, reversals and utilisation.
* Support identification of cost-saving opportunities and improve overall cost controls.

**5. Month-End Closure**

* Support the finance team in month-end closing activities.
* Prepare/review COGS, inventory, provision and related accounting workings.
* Ensure timely booking of inventory adjustments, provisions and other cost-related entries.
* Perform month-end reconciliations and ensure open reconciling items are tracked and resolved.
* Support preparation of MIS and management reporting related to costs, margins and inventory.

**6. MIS & Variance Analysis**

* Prepare periodic cost and variance analysis for management.
* Analyse actual cost vs. standard/budget/prior period.
* Track gross margin movements and identify key cost drivers.
* Prepare dashboards/reports covering COGS, inventory, wastage, yield and cost variances.

**7. Audit & Compliance Support**

* Provide inventory, costing, COGS and provision schedules for statutory/internal audits.
* Support physical stock verification and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trail for costing and inventory-related entries.
* Assist in implementing and strengthening internal controls around inventory and cost accounting.

**WHAT WILL YOU BRING?**

* CMA / Cost Accountant – qualified or with relevant experience in cost accounting.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in cost accounting, inventory accounting, costing or controllership.
* Strong understanding of BOM, standard costing, COGS, inventory valuation, yield/wastage and variance analysis.
* Good Excel and analytical skills, with experience in ERP/accounting systems.
* FMCG / manufacturing/e-commerce experience would be preferred.

**WHAT WILL YOU GET?**

* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, purpose-driven food brand.
* A collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Growth opportunities and skill-building in a dynamic, high-energy environment.

**Starting Date: Immediately**

**Location: Gurgaon**
